sub: Carlos Slim came in too, and the shares sold out in days.

sub: Champions under Javier Irureta, down to the Primera Federación in 2020.

q: Which club's players stood still at kick off in a 2014 cup tie in protest at unpaid wages?

q: Which club plays at El Molinón, a ground in use since 1908?

q: Which Basque club spent one season in La Liga in 1998-99 and has not been back since that decade?
sub: They went up again in 2014 and stayed eight years.
